title: AiocoapResourceTransport.check_security_for_path is an unimplemented no-op yet class is instantiated concretely
description: Spotted during mypy-gate worker6-1nfe. lichen/client/packet_coap.py:296 def check_security_for_path(self, path: str) -> None has an empty body (docstring only), making it implicitly abstract per mypy (python/src/lichen/client/packet_coap.py:153 error [abstract]) — yet AiocoapResourceTransport is instantiated directly at packet_coap.py:153 and tui/native/client.py:46, so security-for-path decisions silently do nothing (no reject path exists). Either implement real enforcement or make it explicitly abstract/subclass-provided; if intended pass-through for trusted local clients, document that decision in code.
